annotations_add.title: Before 004 · routing's redirect of DL-006
annotations_add.text: Our request 003 → routing redirects DL-006 → the counter scans it in → notice 004. The redirect and the transfer to the counter are not recorded, and routing sent no reply of its own; the counter's scan in 004 shows the parcel arrived. Nothing more was needed from us in between: request 003 already asked to be told only on physical receipt.
